title: Island modules
brief: Reorganize the Dynamic Island into modules: Quick settings (default), Performance (CPU, RAM, GPU, disks) and Music player

artboards.title: Pestañas arriba
artboards.tradeoff: Clear and familiar; tabs cost a row and cap the number of modules at ~4

artboards.title: Riel de íconos
artboards.tradeoff: Scales to more modules; island gets 60px wider and less 'pill-like'

artboards.title: Tarjetas de vistazo
artboards.tradeoff: Live glance without navigating; quick settings page grows taller
